description_en: Retrieves a list of query views
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-query-views --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --query-view-scene Alert --query-view-type preset --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListQueryViews

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets belong to the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Your assets belong to regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港，选择该项。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域，选择该项
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The scene to which the query view belongs
parameters.name: query_view_scene

parameters.help_en: The view type. If this parameter is left empty, all views are returned
parameters.help_zh: 视图类型，为空返回全部
parameters.name: query_view_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return when you use the NextToken-based pagination method. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no more results exist. If more results exist, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token
